$header_note: QPB v1.5.7 longer-Mac bug-hunting plan — 4 runs across 4 languages (Rust + JS + C# + Ruby), 4 domains (async runtime + bundler + JSON serializer + job queue), and 4 default branches confirmed via git ls-remote on 2026-05-31. Concurrency: pool={claude:1, copilot:2, codex:1} — all 4 run in parallel after the post-174 simplified manifest-based pool model. Runtime bound by claude/opus on tokio (~30-50 min); other runs finish in parallel. Goal: surface real bugs in active upstream repos that we can log via BUG_REPORT_WORKFLOW. All 4 repos have public issue trackers and active dev. Expects are permissive on gate_result + tight on the v1.5.7 observability assertions (158 banner, 157 gitignore outcome, 162 selfreport, 163 phase0). post-177 BUG-010 fix exercised by tokio (ref=master) and Newtonsoft.Json (ref=master) clones via the retry path if pool starvation hits.

runs.description: Row 0 — claude/opus reviews tokio (Rust async runtime, ref=master) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Largest/most complex target in the plan; opus's capability needed for tokio's 70k+ LOC and concurrency-heavy code. Expect: ~30-50 min runtime, real bug surface in scheduler/runtime/futures/sync primitives.

Row 1 — copilot/gpt-5.4 reviews webpack (JavaScript module bundler, ref=main) via npm-local-tgz (Mode A). Complex transform/loader/plugin pipeline; bugs often in source map generation, resolution, or HMR.

Row 2 — copilot/gpt-5.4 reviews Newtonsoft.Json (C# JSON serializer, ref=master) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Classic edge-case-heavy library; bugs often in deserialization, type coercion, or roundtrip fidelity. Same channel as row 0 (different runner + different repo) for orthogonality.

Row 3 — codex/gpt-5.4 reviews sidekiq (Ruby background-job processor, ref=main) via clone channel (Mode B). codex requires Mode B (single-turn exec). sidekiq's retry/queue/middleware logic is rich in edge cases. clone channel is simplest for Mode B since the bundled run_playbook drives phases directly from the QPB clone.
